fullTextEN: The way Asian kung fu movies and American kung fu movies are made is different.
I am Sika from Taiwan.
How are you?

fullTextEN: Today I want to talk about Jay Chou's story of going to Hollywood.

fullTextZH: 好莱坞是美国的好莱坞吗？

Yes,

fullTextEN: It's the Hollywood in Los Angeles, America, where many movies are made.
But Jay Chou is a singer,

fullTextEN: Why does he want to go to Hollywood?

very popular.

fullTextZH: 所以有电影公司来找周杰伦，
fullTextEN: So a film company approached Jay Chou,
inviting him to make a movie.
Jay Chou thought, um,
I'm a singer, I can't act,

fullTextEN: but the film company kept inviting him, saying come on, come on, so Jay Chou decided, okay,
I'll give it a try.

fullTextZH: 这部电影叫做《头文字 d 》这是周杰伦的第一部电影 ，2007年的时候，
fullTextEN: This movie is called 'Initial D', it is Jay Chou's first movie, in 2007,

fullTextEN: Jay Chou wrote a movie story himself,
He acted in this movie himself,

fullTextEN: Moreover, he was also the director of this movie,

and how actors should perform.

fullTextEN: Of course, the music for this movie was also composed by Jay Chou,

fullTextEN: The name of this movie is 'Secret That Cannot Be Told'

fullTextZH: 这部电影的票房很不错，
fullTextEN: The box office of this movie was quite good,

fullTextZH: 就是很多人买票看电影。
fullTextEN: meaning many people bought tickets to watch the movie.
Jay Chou is a good singer,

fullTextEN: but he is not the best actor.
Many people think,

fullTextEN: I also think the movies he acts in are not good.
But Jay Chou likes challenges,
meaning he is not afraid of difficulties,

fullTextZH: 他喜欢试一试做新的事情，
fullTextEN: he likes to try doing new things,

fullTextEN: so this time he is going to Hollywood to act in a movie.

fullTextEN: Jay Chou's first Hollywood movie is called 'The Green Hornet', and his role is a martial arts-skilled Chinese person,
he can use kung fu to fight bad guys.
For Jay Chou,

fullTextZH: 去好莱坞演电影是一个大挑战，
fullTextEN: going to Hollywood to act in movies is a big challenge,
because his English is not good,
he has to speak English in the movie,

fullTextEN: and he has to speak English with the director and other actors,
when reporters interview him,
he also has to speak English.
Jay Chou's English is not good,

fullTextZH: 可是他很认真学习新的单字，
fullTextEN: but he studies new vocabulary very seriously,
practices English pronunciation,
other actors also help him,

fullTextZH: 所以最后大家都说周杰伦学得很快，
fullTextEN: so in the end, everyone said Jay Chou learned very quickly,
and the movie was performed well.
For this movie,

fullTextEN: Jay Chou was in Los Angeles for three months,

fullTextEN: Jay Chou feels filming in America is more relaxed,
when filming in Asia,

fullTextEN: they are always working, working, working.
when filming in America,

Also,

fullTextEN: The filming methods of Asian kung fu movies and American kung fu movies are different.
When filming kung fu movies in America,

fullTextEN: actors don't really fight each other,
there are fewer actions,
they are more relaxed.

fullTextEN: Asian kung fu movie actors have to do a lot of actions,
they really have to fight each other,
so they are very tired.

fullTextEN: When in Los Angeles, there was another thing that made Jay Chou very happy,

fullTextEN: Do you still remember that Jay Chou hates paparazzi the most?
He is very popular in Asia,
there are always paparazzi following him,
but when he arrived in America,
no one recognized him,

fullTextEN: he could walk on the street very casually,
go to restaurants,
Go to the bar,

Go to many places to have fun

His colleagues then realized: oh,

I didn't listen to his songs before,

But now,

fullTextEN: I think he became a star because he works very hard,
He works very seriously,
So I think he is amazing.
